reason: Both proposals are similar, but Candidate A is more specific and testable: it defines a clear Hf addition of 2–5 at% (replacing Cr and/or V), specifies a wider temperature range (room temperature to 1073 K), and explicitly ties the mechanism to reduced Cr/V mobility and lattice distortion, while Candidate B uses a broader Hf range (4–8 at%) and only mentions 1073 K, making its conditions less precise and its falsification less decisive.
